compliance_decision:
Compliance Answer: Responsible parties must adhere to the accountability obligations outlined in Section 6 of Part II (Financial Reporting and Disclosure) under Title III, Chapter IV-A of FIC Act.
2. Relevant Regulatory Basis: Financial Instrument Compliance Code - Accountable Institutions; specifically, Sections 3(a)(1)-(4), Section 6 (Financial Reporting and Disclosure) under Title III, Chapter IV-A of the FIC Act as referenced in Chunk 6123.
3. Explanation: Responsible parties are obligated to ensure accurate financial reporting by maintaining proper records that reflect their transactions accurately (Section 6(a)). They must also disclose relevant information timely and transparently, without undue delay or omission of material facts as required in Section 6(b). Failure to comply with these obligations can result in sanctions under the FIC Act.
